aufuggerei.name: Fuggerei
aufuggerei.slogan: A rent of one gulden a year, unchanged for five centuries.
aufuggerei.line: Founded by Jakob Fugger in 1516, its 67 houses still charge a yearly rent of one Rhenish gulden, about 0.88 euros.

aunoerdlingenstadtmauer.name: Nördlingen Town Wall
aunoerdlingenstadtmauer.slogan: A medieval ring still closed around a meteorite crater.
aunoerdlingenstadtmauer.line: Nördlingen sits inside the 25 km Ries crater, and its 90 m church tower is built of rock made by the impact.

aurathaus.name: Augsburg Town Hall
aurathaus.slogan: A golden hall under a ceiling fourteen metres high.
aurathaus.line: Elias Holl laid its foundation stone in 1615, and its Golden Hall covers about 552 square metres.

auharburgburg.name: Harburg Castle
auharburgburg.slogan: A Staufer fortress holding the Wörnitz valley since 1150.
auharburgburg.line: First mentioned in 1150, the castle has belonged to the Oettingen family since 1299.

aupuppenkiste.name: Augsburger Puppenkiste
aupuppenkiste.slogan: Strings, wooden heads and Germany's best-loved bedtime stories.
aupuppenkiste.line: Walter Oehmichen opened the marionette theatre in 1948 with Puss in Boots, and later filmed Jim Knopf there in 1961.
